bootstrap_method: Participant-cluster percentile bootstrap; same participant draws for model comparisons; repeated rows travel together and each drawn cluster occurrence has total metric weight one. No-positive AP and one-class ROC undefined; undefined denominators omitted metric-by-metric with counts.
metric_definition: Stepwise weighted average_precision_score equivalent, not trapezoidal PR-AUC; weighted tie-aware ROC. Undefined AP when no positive weight; undefined ROC when either class absent. Precision/recall/specificity/F1 undefined on zero denominators.
timing_decision: C; no survival model or supported elapsed horizons
survey_weighting: No matching survey weights/design; no national inference

app_input_coverage.evaluation_policy: All locked valid-outcome test records evaluated; app input-count guard is descriptive coverage, not a post-hoc test exclusion

test_exposure_policy: First recorded answer access in this run; predictions saved once; reruns must reuse complete saved evidence.
